thread:
marta: Canary promote for ai-ingress chart v2.4.1 -> staging failed. deploy-bot: initContainer 'verify-perms' ExitCode=1 due to RBAC forbidden. promo auto-hold. Anyone see the init logs?

deploy-bot: promote-blocked: init-failure verify-perms, pod ai-ingress-canary-xyz CrashLoopBackOff; action=hold; logs: kubectl -n staging logs pod/ai-ingress-canary-xyz -c verify-perms

josh: looking. verify-perms tries to list customresources for crd 'ingressconfigs.redwood.ai' but gets forbidden. I think values.staging.serviceAccountOverride removed some verbs in the overlay.

priya: correct — overlay change yesterday reduced RBAC scope to only get/list on core resources to tighten perms; forgot CRD verbs.

marta: options: 1) patch canary SA to add missing verbs and re-promote (quick), 2) pin staging back to v2.4.0 and abort (safe), 3) revert overlay and re-run after PR merge (20-40m).

josh: patching SA for canary is fastest to unblock staging, but we should avoid permanent mismatches between chart and overlay. If this goes to prod, we want RBAC fixed in chart.

priya: agree. let's do a temporary canary SA patch, then open PR to add the missing CRD verbs to the overlay and add an automated RBAC sanity check to preflight.

marta: ok i'll apply the SA patch and restart the canary once PR is opened. I'll also note a manual temporary workaround in the release tracker.

deploy-bot: action=temporary_patch, user=marta, resource=serviceaccount/ai-ingress-canary-sa, patch="add: verbs: [list,get,watch] for ingressconfigs.redwood.ai", timestamp=1758888895

josh: applied patch and restarted canary pod. verify-perms now completes and canary progresses.

priya: opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/512 — adds crd verbs to staging overlay and adds kube-rbac-probe to canary job for future checks.

marta: release-note snippet: "Canary promotion to v2.4.1 temporarily blocked in staging due to RBAC overlay omission; temporary SA patch applied. Follow-up PR landed to restore CRD verbs and add RBAC preflight. No production impact."

josh: documenting audit commands used:
```
kubectl -n staging logs pod/ai-ingress-canary-xyz -c verify-perms
kubectl -n staging patch sa ai-ingress-canary-sa --patch '{"rules":[{"apiGroups":["redwood.ai"],"resources":["ingressconfigs"],"verbs":["get","list","watch"]}]}'
kubectl -n staging delete pod ai-ingress-canary-xyz
```

marta: thanks. marking the promo as resumed in the tracker and linking PR. Will follow up with release notes update. :white_check_mark:
